headline: HDMC gains offset HDFS pullback; guidance raised
summary_short: Harley-Davidson posted Q2 FY2026 revenue of $1,230.4M (+4.9% q/q, -5.9% y/y) and diluted EPS of $0.75, as HDMC operating income rose 18% y/y while HDFS income fell 69% on its shift to a capital-light lending model; the company raised full-year guidance.
summary_long: Revenue was $1,230.4M (+4.9% q/q, -5.9% y/y); the y/y decline reflects a 55% drop in HDFS revenue from lower retail finance receivables after 2025 loan-asset sales, partly offset by 6% HDMC growth on higher shipments and favorable FX. Operating income of $76.0M (-32.4% y/y) reflects a 69% HDFS operating-income decline against an 18% HDMC increase. HDMC gross margin fell 108bp y/y to 27.5% on mix, pricing and FX, partly offset by manufacturing costs including a tariff recovery. Diluted EPS was $0.75, down 14.8% y/y. Cash rose to $1,895.8M (+19.4% y/y). Harley-Davidson raised FY2026 guidance for HDMC/HDFS operating income and unit volumes.

drivers.explanation: Y/y decline driven by a 55% drop in HDFS revenue as retail finance receivables shrank after 2025 loan-asset sales; HDMC revenue rose 6% on higher shipments and favorable FX, partly offset by pricing.
Down 32% y/y as HDFS operating income fell 69% on a smaller loan portfolio and lower interest and credit-loss expense, partially offset by an 18% increase in HDMC operating income.
Net income attributable to Harley-Davidson fell 26% y/y, mainly reflecting HDFS's shift toward a capital-light financing model, partly offset by improved HDMC results.
HDMC gross margin fell 108bp y/y to 27.5% on unfavorable product mix, net pricing, raw materials and FX, partly offset by manufacturing-cost favorability including a tariff recovery.
Share count fell 11% y/y after the company repurchased $158 million of stock (7.9 million shares) in H1 2026 on a discretionary basis.
Management cited strength in domestic retail, healthy dealer inventory levels, and progress on the 'Back to the Bricks' strategy as the basis for raising full-year guidance.
